import ctypes

# Load the GSL libraries
cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_combination structure
class gsl_combination(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("n", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("k", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t))]

# Specify argument and return types for the GSL functions
gsl.gsl_combination_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_combination_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_combination)
gsl.gsl_combination_init_first.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_combination)]
gsl.gsl_combination_init_first.restype = None
gsl.gsl_combination_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_combination)]
gsl.gsl_combination_free.restype = None

def create_first_combination(n, k):
    if n <= 0 or k > n:
        return None
    comb_ptr = gsl.gsl_combination_alloc(n, k)
    if not comb_ptr:
        return None
    gsl.gsl_combination_init_first(comb_ptr)
    data = [comb_ptr.contents.data[i] for i in range(k)] if k > 0 else []
    gsl.gsl_combination_free(comb_ptr)
    return data

def assert_test():
    # Test normal case
    result = create_first_combination(5, 3)
    assert result == [0, 1, 2], f"Expected [0, 1, 2], got {result}"
    
    # Test k=0
    result = create_first_combination(5, 0)
    assert result == [], f"Expected [], got {result}"
    
    # Test k=n
    result = create_first_combination(4, 4)
    assert result == [0, 1, 2, 3], f"Expected [0, 1, 2, 3], got {result}"
    
    # Test invalid input (k > n)
    result = create_first_combination(3, 5)
    assert result is None, f"Expected None for k > n, got {result}"
    
    # Test invalid input (n=0)
    result = create_first_combination(0, 2)
    assert result is None, f"Expected None for n=0, got {result}"
    
    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
